title: Daily IAM Market Briefing for Leaders and Technical Practitioners
summary: The IAM market is shifting from static access control to dynamic, AI-driven security enforcement, with critical gaps emerging in real-time governance of AI agents and integrated identity workflows. This integration directly addresses a critical operational gap where governance teams define access but security teams manually enforce it, leading to potential security risks from outdated credentials. The ARISE Framework addresses a critical gap in AI agent security where traditional identity tools fail to enforce real-time permissions checks, risking unauthorized actions by agents with valid credentials but no human oversight. This integration directly addresses the risk of AI-generated activities appearing legitimate while bypassing traditional access controls, enabling proactive governance of AI identities.
